# World Economic Forum

> > The World Economic Forum provides global thought leadership on AI transformation, geopolitical risk, corporate strategy, and sustainable development through curated insights from world leaders and experts.

The World Economic Forum is a platform for exploring critical global challenges including artificial intelligence adoption, geopolitical dynamics, corporate innovation, and resource sustainability. Content spans Davos conferences, topic hubs, and expert analysis on how organizations and nations can navigate rapid technological and geopolitical change.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- AI Transformation
- Corporate Strategy
- Davos 2026
- Geopolitics
- Geopolitical Risk
- Organizational Change
- Enterprise AI Adoption
- Global Cooperation
- Water Security
- Talent & Skills
- Innovation
- Economic Growth
- Sustainable Development
- Middle East Economics

## Davos 2026 Leadership Insights

- [Strengthening global cooperation in a contested world](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/01/we-asked-leaders-davos-2026-how-can-cooperate-more-contested-geopolitical-world-heres-what-they-said): Davos 2026 coverage on global cooperation and multilateral solutions to geopolitical challenges.
- [How can we better invest in people's prosperity, health, skills and jobs? Davos 2026](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/01/leaders-davos-2026-how-can-we-invest-in-peoples-prosperity-health-skills-and-jobs): Davos 2026 discussion on addressing inequality, AI disruption and human capital investment.
- [Leaders at Davos 2026 on deploying innovation and technology at scale and responsibly](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/01/leaders-at-davos-2026-on-deploying-innovation-and-technology-at-scale-responsibly): Davos 2026 insights on responsible innovation and scaling technology deployment effectively.

## AI Transformation & Enterprise Strategy

- [Organizational Transformation in the Age of AI: How Organizations Maximize AI's Potential](https://www.weforum.org/publications/organizational-transformation-in-the-age-of-ai-how-organizations-maximize-ais-potential): Guide on embedding AI across operations, R&D, strategy and talent for organizational transformation.
- [Redefining corporate strategy in a more volatile world](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/03/how-corporate-strategy-is-changing-in-a-world-of-constant-shocks): Article on how companies adapt strategies amid geopolitical, AI and energy shocks.
- [Business](https://www.weforum.org/stories/business): Topic hub covering business innovation, corporate strategy, AI and economic growth.

## Geopolitics & Global Economics

- [Geo-Economics and Politics](https://www.weforum.org/stories/geo-economics-and-politics): Topic hub analyzing global geo-economics, geopolitics and international relations dynamics.
- [The global price tag of war in the Middle East](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/03/the-global-price-tag-of-war-in-the-middle-east): Analysis of Middle East conflict's economic impact on global markets and supply chains.

## Sustainability & Global Resources

- [Food and Water](https://www.weforum.org/stories/food-water-air): Topic hub featuring stories on food and water security with sustainable resource management insights.
- [What is World Water Day?](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/03/world-water-day-march-2026): Article on World Water Day observance exploring water, gender equality and global water security.
